verses.sloka: शृणु राजन्महासत्व यदर्थमहमागतः ।पितामहेन देवेन प्रेषितो ऽस्मि महाबल ।। ७.१०४.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: śṛṇu rājanmahāsatva yadarthamahamāgataḥ ।pitāmahena devena preṣito 'smi mahābala ।। 7.104.1 ॥

translations.english: The sage then began, asking Rama to listen, and revealed that he had been sent by the divine grandfather Brahma for a specific purpose.
translations.hindi: +६०:-- सप्ताशीतितमः सगः तच्छुत्वा लक्ष्मेणेनोक्तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः । प्रत्युवाच महातेजाः प्रहसन्‌ राघवो वचः

verses.sloka: तवाहं पूर्वसद्भावे पुत्रः परपुरञ्जय ।मायासम्भावितो वीर कालः सर्वसमाहरः ।। ७.१०४.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tavāhaṁ pūrvasadbhāve putraḥ parapurañjaya ।māyāsambhāvito vīra kālaḥ sarvasamāharaḥ ।। 7.104.2 ॥

translations.english: O conqueror of enemy cities, O hero, I am your son from a previous existence, created by your divine power as Time, the destroyer of all.
translations.hindi: हे नरश्रेष्ठ लक्ष्मण ! तुमने जो यह कथा कही सो ऐसी हीं है । वृत्रासुर के वध की कथा अर अश्वमेघ का फल ऐसा ही है

verses.sloka: पितामहश्च भगवानाह लोकपतिः प्रभुः ।समयस्ते कृतः सौम्य लोकान्सम्परिरक्षितुम् ।। ७.१०४.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: pitāmahaśca bhagavānāha lokapatiḥ prabhuḥ ।samayaste kṛtaḥ saumya lokānsamparirakṣitum ।। 7.104.3 ॥

translations.english: And the revered Grandfather Brahma, the mighty lord of the worlds, said, "O gentle one, an agreement has been made by you to protect the worlds well."
translations.hindi: हे सौम्य ! मैंने सुना है कि, पूवकाल में कदम प्रजापति के ज्येष्ठ पुत्र, जिसका नाम इल था, बड़े घमात्मा थे और बाहीक देश में राज्य करते थे

verses.sloka: सङ्क्षिप्य हि पुरा लोकान्मायया स्वयमेव हि ।महार्णवे शयानो ऽप्सु मां त्वं पूर्वमजीजनः ।। ७.१०४.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: saṅkṣipya hi purā lokānmāyayā svayameva hi ।mahārṇave śayāno 'psu māṁ tvaṁ pūrvamajījanaḥ ।। 7.104.4 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, formerly, having dissolved the worlds by your own divine power, you lay in the great ocean and begot me in the waters.

verses.sloka: भोगवन्तं ततो नागमनन्तमुदकेशयम् ।मायया जनयित्वा त्वं द्वौ च सत्त्वौ महाबलौ ।। ७.१०४.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhogavantaṁ tato nāgamanantamudakeśayam ।māyayā janayitvā tvaṁ dvau ca sattvau mahābalau ।। 7.104.5 ॥

translations.english: Then, having created by your divine power the hooded serpent Ananta, who lies in the water, you also created two very powerful beings.
translations.hindi: हें रघुनन्दन ! बड़े उदार देवता, मह्दाघनी दैत्य, नाग, राक्षस गन्धर्व ओर यक्ष उनसे डरते थे और उनका सदा सम्मान करते थे ¡ उनके ( राजा इल फे ) क्रुद्ध होने पर तीनों लोक भयभीत हो जाते थे

verses.sloka: मधुं च कैटभं चैव ययोरस्थिचयैर्वृता ।इयं पर्वतसम्बाधा मेदिनी चाभवन्मही ।। ७.१०४.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: madhuṁ ca kaiṭabhaṁ caiva yayorasthicayairvṛtā ।iyaṁ parvatasambādhā medinī cābhavanmahī ।। 7.104.6 ॥

translations.english: These two were Madhu and Kaitabha, whose heaps of bones covered this earth, which then became the great earth crowded with mountains.

verses.sloka: पद्मे दिव्ये ऽर्कसङ्काशे नाभ्यामुत्पाद्य मामपि ।प्राजापत्यं त्वया कर्म मयि सर्वं निवेशितम् ।। ७.१०४.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: padme divye 'rkasaṅkāśe nābhyāmutpādya māmapi ।prājāpatyaṁ tvayā karma mayi sarvaṁ niveśitam ।। 7.104.7 ॥

translations.english: Having created me from your divine, sun-like lotus navel, you entrusted all the work of creation to me.
translations.hindi: परमोदार महायशस्वी, धर्मात्मा और वीयंवान राजा इल इस प्रकार बड़ी बुद्धिमत्ता से बाहींक देरा का शासन करते थे

verses.sloka: सो ऽहं सन्न्यस्तभारो हि त्वामुपासे जगत्पतिम् ।रक्षां विधत्स्व भूतेषु मम तेजस्करो भवान् ।। ७.१०४.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: so 'haṁ sannyastabhāro hi tvāmupāse jagatpatim ।rakṣāṁ vidhatsva bhūteṣu mama tejaskaro bhavān ।। 7.104.8 ॥

translations.english: Having indeed relinquished that burden, I now worship you, the Lord of the world; please bestow protection upon all beings and increase my splendor.
translations.hindi: एक बार चैत्रमास में वह राजा अपनी सेना आदि ले कर, _ चन में शिकार खेलने के लिए गया

translations.english: Therefore, you also, from that unassailable and eternal state, assumed the form of Vishnu for the protection of all beings.

verses.sloka: अदित्यां वीर्यवान्पुत्रो भ्रातऽणां वीर्यवर्धनः ।समुत्पन्नेषु कृत्येषु तेषां साह्याय कल्पसे ।। ७.१०४.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: adityāṁ vīryavānputro bhrāta'ṇāṁ vīryavardhanaḥ ।samutpanneṣu kṛtyeṣu teṣāṁ sāhyāya kalpase ।। 7.104.10 ॥

translations.english: As a powerful son born to Aditi, increasing the valor of your brothers, you become capable of assisting them when difficulties arise.
translations.hindi: विविध प्रकार के दस हज़ार हिरनों को मारे कर, वह राजा (शकार खेलता हुआ उस वन में पहुँचा जहाँ स्वामिकातिक का जन्म हुआ था

verses.sloka: स त्वं वित्रास्यमानासु प्रजासु जगतां वर ।रावणस्य वधाकाङ्क्षी मानुषेषु मनो ऽदधाः ।। ७.१०४.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tvaṁ vitrāsyamānāsu prajāsu jagatāṁ vara ।rāvaṇasya vadhākāṅkṣī mānuṣeṣu mano 'dadhāḥ ।। 7.104.11 ॥

translations.english: O best of the worlds, when the creatures were being terrified, you, desiring the slaying of Ravana, set your mind on being born among humans.
translations.hindi: उस बन भें दुधषं देवादिदेव महादेव जी पावती जी के साथ अपने समस्त अनुचरों सहित बिहार कर रहे थे

verses.sloka: दश वर्षसहस्राणि दश वर्षशतानि च ।कृत्वा वासस्य नियतिं स्वयमेवात्मना पुरा ।। ७.१०४.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: daśa varṣasahasrāṇi daśa varṣaśatāni ca ।kṛtvā vāsasya niyatiṁ svayamevātmanā purā ।। 7.104.12 ॥

translations.english: Formerly, you yourself fixed the duration of your dwelling (on earth) for ten thousand and ten hundred years.
translations.hindi: उस समय वृषध्वज शिब जी ने पावती को प्रसन्न करने के लिए अपना रूप खो का बना लिआ था ओर वे पहाड़ी झरनों के निकट घूम फिर रहे थे

verses.sloka: स त्वं मनोमयः पुत्रः पूर्णायुर्मानुषेष्विह ।कालो ऽयं ते नरश्रेष्ठ समीपमुपवर्तितुम् ।। ७.१०४.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tvaṁ manomayaḥ putraḥ pūrṇāyurmānuṣeṣviha ।kālo 'yaṁ te naraśreṣṭha samīpamupavartitum ।। 7.104.13 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, you, the mind-born son, have completed your lifespan among humans here, and now it is time for you to return to my proximity.
translations.hindi: उस समय उस वन में जितने पुरुषवाची वृक्ष सृगादिक थे, चे सब ( शिव जी के प्रभाव से ) खोबाची हो गए ये

verses.sloka: यदि भूयो महाराज प्रजा इच्छस्युपासितुम् ।वस वा वीर भद्रं त एवमाह पितामहः ।। ७.१०४.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi bhūyo mahārāja prajā icchasyupāsitum ।vasa vā vīra bhadraṁ ta evamāha pitāmahaḥ ।। 7.104.14 ॥

translations.english: The grandfather (Brahma) said, "O great king, if you desire to rule your subjects again, or if you wish to stay, O hero, may good fortune be upon you."
translations.hindi: अधिक क्या कहा जाय जोन जोन उस समय उस बन में थे वे सब के सब स्त्री रूप हो गए थे। उसी समय "देम के पुत्र राजा इल भी

verses.sloka: अथ वा विजिगीषा ते सुरलोकाय राघव ।सनाथा विष्णुना देवा भवन्तु विगतज्वराः ।। ७.१०४.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: atha vā vijigīṣā te suralokāya rāghava ।sanāthā viṣṇunā devā bhavantu vigatajvarāḥ ।। 7.104.15 ॥

translations.english: Or, O Raghava, if you desire to return to the world of the gods, then may the gods be protected by Vishnu and be free from all distress.

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा पितामहेनोक्तं वाक्यं कालसमीरितम् ।राघवः प्रहसन्वाक्यं सर्वसंहारमब्रवीत् ।। ७.१०४.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā pitāmahenoktaṁ vākyaṁ kālasamīritam ।rāghavaḥ prahasanvākyaṁ sarvasaṁhāramabravīt ।। 7.104.16 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words spoken by the grandfather, which indicated the end of his time, Rama smiled and spoke words signifying the dissolution of everything.
translations.hindi: हे रघुनन्दन ! तइनन्तर जब उसने अपनी और अपनी सेना की ओर दृष्ट डाली, तब उसने देखा-कि, वह स्वयं और उसकी सेना के सब लोग, खो बन गए हूँ। यह देख, वह बड़ा दुःखी हुआ

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा मे देवदेवस्य वाक्यं परममद्भुतम् ।प्रीतिर्हि महती जाता तवागमनसम्भवा ।। ७.१०४.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā me devadevasya vākyaṁ paramamadbhutam ।prītirhi mahatī jātā tavāgamanasambhavā ।। 7.104.17 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the supreme and wonderful words of the god of gods, a great joy has indeed arisen in me, caused by your arrival.
translations.hindi: जब उसने यहद जाना कि, शिव जी के प्रभाव से ऐसा हुआ है, तब वह राजा अत्यन्त भयभीत हो अपने अनुचरों, सैनिकों ओर वाहनों सहित; शितिकण्ठ, कपर्दी, महात्मा और देवदेव महादेव जी के शरण में गया | तब वरदानी शङ्कुर पावती सहित हँस कर

verses.sloka: त्रयाणामपि लोकानां कार्यार्थं मम सम्भवः ।भद्रं ते ऽस्तु गमिष्यामि यत एवाहमागतः ।। ७.१०४.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: trayāṇāmapi lokānāṁ kāryārthaṁ mama sambhavaḥ ।bhadraṁ te 'stu gamiṣyāmi yata evāhamāgataḥ ।। 7.104.18 ॥

translations.english: My existence is for the purpose of the three worlds; may good fortune be to you, I shall now depart to the place from where I came.

verses.sloka: हद्गतो ह्यसि सम्प्राप्तो न मे तत्र विचारणा ।मया हि सर्वकृत्येषु देवानां वशवर्तिनाम् ।स्थातव्यं सर्वसंहार यथा ह्याह पितामहः ।। ७.१०४.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: hadgato hyasi samprāpto na me tatra vicāraṇā ।mayā hi sarvakṛtyeṣu devānāṁ vaśavartinām ।sthātavyaṁ sarvasaṁhāra yathā hyāha pitāmahaḥ ।। 7.104.19 ।।

translations.english: You are indeed understood and your time has arrived, there is no doubt in my mind about that; for I must indeed act in all duties, obedient to the gods, for the destruction of all, just as the grandfather Brahma has indeed commanded. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुरधिकशततमः सर्गः ।। 104 ।। Thus ends the hundred and fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
